about_the_game:
(Note: This Demo version is for feasibility testing only. The final version may differ somewhat from this version.)

Chaos Games: N-in-1 is a casual game that endeavors to combine the design philosophies of multiple retro classics and new games.

Control a variety of characters with vastly different handling characteristics to survive in time-limited levels while continuously obtaining special upgrades. At the same time, the upgrades you choose will also enhance your enemies – even causing foes that shouldn’t normally appear to barge in.

To help you quickly get accustomed to the various character controls, the game employs an extremely easy-to-pick-up control scheme – for the most part, you’ll only be using the directional keys and a single function button.

In this Demo test, you can try controlling several different characters, each with completely different control logic and initial enemies. After completing a level, you can choose upgrade options to continuously strengthen yourself, and in the upcoming levels, more enhanced enemies will appear.

Feasibility Test Version

Unfortunately, we have currently encountered some issues with the development cycle. At this point, we can only release this Demo version to verify the technological feasibility.

We fully recognize that this version is merely "functional" and is far from being entertaining.It also severely lacks a sufficient number of playable characters, level content, numerous upgrade options, and more. While the programming design work is essentially complete, many unforeseen circumstances arose during implementation, causing the development progress to fall far behind the original plan.

We are still working hard to make it better. Whether or not you like it, we are truly grateful for your patience and support.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64bit
  • Processor: x64 architecture with SSE2 instruction set support
  • Memory: 1 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DX11, DX12 capable
  • Storage: 3 GB available space

short_description: A fusion game brimming with "chaos" and "glitches"! Command familiar characters, confront unexpected foes, and endure! Each level cleared offers a major upgrade, yet ushers in increasingly chaotic and complex stages due to your decisions. Is it a crisis or an opportunity?
